administratorsPageDescription: Accounts with the administrator role can open this administration. A change applies from the account's next request.
administratorsEmpty: No account holds the administrator role.
administratorsGrantDescription: Enter the email the person signs in to Deskohub with. They must have signed in to Deskohub at least once.
administratorsGrantAlreadyAdministrator: {email} already has the administrator role. Nothing changed.
administratorsGrantAccountNotFound: No Deskohub account signs in with this email. Ask the person to sign in to Deskohub once with this email, then try again.
administratorsGrantFailed: The administrator role could not be granted. Try again.
administratorsEmailTooLong: The email address can have at most {max} characters.
administratorsRevokeDescription: {email} loses access to the administration on their next request. You can grant the role again later.
administratorsRevokeRevoked: {email} no longer has the administrator role.
administratorsRevokeUnchanged: {email} no longer had the administrator role.
administratorsRevokeSelf: You can't revoke your own administrator role.
administratorsRevokeFailed: The administrator role could not be revoked. Try again.
administratorsServerUnreachable: The server could not be reached. Try again.
